set.description: Chat and messaging: chat interfaces, SDKs for messaging platforms, and chat applications.
Clients and tools that fetch, cache, and type remote data from APIs (GraphQL, REST, OpenAPI, RPC).
Databases and storage engines usable from JavaScript: in-memory, in-browser, embedded, or syncing, including low-level drivers. ORMs and query builders are not databases.
Peer-to-peer and decentralized web projects that work without a central server, such as IPFS, ActivityPub, or P2P file sharing.
Projects that provide or help build a design system: a set of design guidelines implemented as reusable components and tokens.
Frameworks that run on both the client and the server. Server-only frameworks belong in Node.js framework.
Unstyled UI components that provide behavior and accessibility, leaving styling to the user.
Libraries of reusable hooks or composables for UI frameworks, such as React hooks or Vue composables. Combine with the framework's ecosystem tag.
Desktop apps for writing and organizing notes in Markdown.
Projects about the JavaScript ecosystem itself, such as catalogs, curated lists, and package browsers, including Best of JS.
Run without a network connection, or detect online and offline status.
